description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Deadly Aim, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (Blitzball), BAB +1

Benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single ranged attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within 5 increments of your blitzball. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is within 1 range increment of the first target as the blitzball bounces between them. You can only make one additional attack per round with this feat. When you use this feat, you take a -2 penalty to your Armor Class until your next turn.

system.requirements: Str 13, Deadly Aim, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (Blitzball), BAB +1
